description: This is the main source file for a Flutter application that manages notes. It contains UI components, state management, and interactions with the notes database. The file defines the main app widget, home page, and navigational flows for creating, viewing, editing, and deleting notes.

classes.name: NotesApp
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that sets the theme and home page of the application.

classes.name: NotesHomePage
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that manages the main notes list, search functionality, and navigational elements.

classes.name: _NotesHomePageState
classes.description: State class for NotesHomePage, managing the core logic, UI state, notes retrieval, handling user actions like add/edit/delete, and building the UI.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree of the main app, including AppBar, body content, floating action button, and bottom navigation bar.

methods.name: _getNotes
methods.description: Fetches the list of notes from the database based on current search query.

methods.name: _onSearchChanged
methods.description: Updates the search query and refreshes the notes list when the search input changes.

methods.name: _onDeleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the specified note from the database and refreshes the list.

methods.name: _onEditNote
methods.description: Navigates to the note editing page and updates the note upon return.

methods.name: _onAddNote
methods.description: Creates a new note and inserts it into the database.

methods.name: _onNoteTap
methods.description: Opens the note detail page for viewing/editing the selected note.

methods.name: _notesListBuilder
methods.description: Builds the UI list of notes, including dismissible and editable list tiles.

methods.name: _mainContentWidget
methods.description: Determines which main content to display based on navigation index.
